parameters.name: username
parameters.description: username of the user whose data is to be edited

active.description: Whether the user account is active

admin.description: Whether the user has administrator privileges

allow_create_organization.description: Whether the user can create organizations

allow_git_hook.description: Whether the user can use Git hooks

allow_import_local.description: Whether the user can import local repositories

description.description: The user's personal description or bio

email.description: The email address of the user

full_name.description: The full display name of the user

login_name.description: identifier of the user, provided by the external authenticator (if configured)

max_repo_creation.description: Maximum number of repositories the user can create

must_change_password.description: Whether the user must change password on next login

password.description: The plain text password for the user

prohibit_login.description: Whether the user is prohibited from logging in

restricted.description: Whether the user has restricted access privileges

source_id.description: The authentication source ID to associate with the user

visibility.description: User visibility level: public, limited, or private

Token.name: token
Token.description: This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.

AccessToken.name: access_token
AccessToken.description: This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.

AuthorizationHeaderToken.name: Authorization
AuthorizationHeaderToken.description: API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.

SudoParam.name: sudo
SudoParam.description: Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.

SudoHeader.name: Sudo
SudoHeader.description: Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.

TOTPHeader.name: X-GITEA-OTP
TOTPHeader.description: Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.
